## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the checks run and any remaining limitations. Include a capture for visible
UI changes. Note packaging, compatibility or license changes when relevant.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and linked to an issue when applicable.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed, or remaining limitations are described above.
- [ ] Documentation, screenshots and source records match the resulting behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data or unrelated generated files are included.
- [ ] New dependencies or assets include their required licenses and notices.
